fact: Car 11 had 6 sets of blue flags displayed prior to the lapped car behind passing.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5 e) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, and in-car video evidence. Although Car 11 received six blue flag signals, and at times provided room for the lapping car to overtake and reduced speed, the car behind did not overtake until after Turn 9. The Stewards determined that the driver of Car 11 took all reasonable actions and hence decide to take no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 11 Ignoring Blue Flags
to: The Team Manager, Cadillac Formula 1 Team
